description: The exact wording of the three write violations DML can fail on - NULL into a NOT NULL column, a value too long for its VARCHAR(n), and a non-numeric string into a numeric column - pinned across INSERT, INSERT...SELECT, UPDATE and MERGE, each in the per-statement envelope naming the table and column (live-verified wording). Converted 1:1 from constraints/WriteViolationMessageTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE nn (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO nn VALUES (1, NULL)

error.messageContains: DML operation to table NN failed on column NAME with error: NULL result in a non-nullable column

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE nn (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO nn SELECT 2, NULL

error.messageContains: DML operation to table NN failed on column NAME with error: NULL result in a non-nullable column

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE nn (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO nn VALUES (3, 'ok')
UPDATE nn SET name = NULL WHERE id = 3

error.messageContains: DML operation to table NN failed on column NAME with error: NULL result in a non-nullable column

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE nn (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO src VALUES (9, NULL)
MERGE INTO nn t USING src s ON t.id = s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, name) VALUES (s.id, s.name)

error.messageContains: DML operation to table NN failed on column NAME with error: NULL result in a non-nullable column

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE tl (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(3))
INSERT INTO tl VALUES (1, 'abcdefgh')

error.messageContains: DML operation to table TL failed on column NAME with error: String 'abcdefgh' is too long and would be truncated

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE tl (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(3))
INSERT INTO tl SELECT 2, 'abcdefgh'

error.messageContains: DML operation to table TL failed on column NAME with error: String 'abcdefgh' is too long and would be truncated

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE tl (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(3))
INSERT INTO tl VALUES (3, 'ab')
UPDATE tl SET name = 'abcdefgh' WHERE id = 3

error.messageContains: DML operation to table TL failed on column NAME with error: String 'abcdefgh' is too long and would be truncated

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE tl (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR(3))
CREATE TABLE src (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO src VALUES (9, 'abcdefgh')
MERGE INTO tl t USING src s ON t.id = s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, name) VALUES (s.id, s.name)

error.messageContains: DML operation to table TL failed on column NAME with error: String 'abcdefgh' is too long and would be truncated

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE nv (id INTEGER)
INSERT INTO nv VALUES ('BADX')

error.messageContains: DML operation to table NV failed on column ID with error: Numeric value 'BADX' is not recognized
